# Project: Ledger

## Stack
- python 3.12
- sqlite

## Forbidden
- network calls at import time

## NFRs
- p95 latency under 200 ms


## Project Rules (MUST follow)

- Money is integer cents, never float.

## Prior Architecture Decisions (stay consistent; do NOT re-litigate)

# ADR US-0000: storage

- Status: approved by operator

Use sqlite.

## Existing codebase (interfaces only — integrate with these, do not rewrite)

- ledger/__init__.py  (no public interfaces)
- ledger/invoices.py
  - class Invoice
    - total_cents(self)
  - def load(path: str) -> list[Invoice]

## Reviewer feedback to address (your previous design was rejected)

Revise the design to resolve these points; do not simply re-propose it:
- Use a view, not a table.

## Story

```json
{
  "verdict": "pass",
  "story_id": "US-0099",
  "title": "Overdue invoices",
  "problem": "Operators cannot see which invoices are late.",
  "why": "Late invoices cost money.",
  "acceptance_criteria": [
    "An invoice unpaid 30 days after issue is listed as overdue",
    "The overdue list is sorted oldest first"
  ],
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-0001",
      "title": "Overdue query",
      "purpose": "find late invoices"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-0002",
      "title": "Overdue listing",
      "purpose": "show them",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-0001"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "questions": []
}
```

## Original Request

List invoices that are overdue, oldest first.

Design the technical approach for this story. You MUST stay within the project specification above, honor the Project Rules, and stay consistent with the Prior Architecture Decisions. Do not introduce technologies, patterns, or modules not listed in the spec.
